note: Ten fictional cases. Every rate is invented. These numbers are inputs, not expected outputs. Expected PPV, NPV, NNE and NNT live in fixtures.json and were not computed by app.js.

cases.title: Blue Kite ward alert
cases.scenario: A fictional ward dashboard raises a Blue Kite alert for an invented sudden decline when a made-up score reaches 8 out of 10.
cases.threshold: Fictional score of 8 or higher out of 10.
cases.action: The alert triggers a fictional bedside review.

cases.title: Paper Crane clinic screen
cases.scenario: A fictional clinic screen raises a Paper Crane flag for an invented rare condition when its score reaches 7 out of 10.
cases.threshold: Fictional score of 7 or higher out of 10.
cases.action: The alert triggers a fictional confirmatory visit.

cases.title: Glass Finch perfect-specificity screen
cases.scenario: A fictional booth screen raises a Glass Finch flag for an invented finding only on a pattern that, in this made-up model, never appears in people without the finding.
cases.threshold: Fictional pattern match. In this made-up model the specificity at that threshold is 100%.
cases.action: The alert triggers a fictional early referral.

cases.threshold: Fictional score of 6 or higher out of 10.
cases.action: The alert triggers a fictional monitoring step.
